name: Vaibhav Bajpai
tagline: I build AI-powered full-stack products — LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and intelligent automation, backed by production-grade React, Node.js, and cloud infrastructure.
bio: I'm an AI Full Stack Software Engineer with experience building scalable web and mobile applications using Python, TypeScript, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and AWS. I specialize in developing end-to-end solutions with secure REST APIs, role-based access control, authentication, and cloud-native architectures. I also build AI-powered applications by integrating LLMs (Gemini/OpenAI), prompt engineering, AI APIs, RAG, and intelligent automation to deliver production-ready solutions. Passionate about clean architecture and modern AI technologies, I enjoy building scalable, high-performance applications from concept to deployment.
